title: Life Less - LifeSteal Datapack
description: LIFELESS is a Lifesteal-inspired Minecraft datapack where every death permanently reduces your maximum health, every kill grants a heart, and losing your last heart results in elimination.
body:
# ❤ **LIFELESS**

**LIFELESS** is a datapack inspired by the well-known **Lifesteal** game mode, where **every death has permanent consequences**.

Instead of having a fixed amount of health, each player has a number of **permanent hearts**. These hearts can be lost upon death or gained by eliminating other players.

Every decision matters. Every battle can make you stronger... or bring you one step closer to permanent elimination.

🌍 Available in: Spanish (ES) 🇪🇸 & English (US) 🇺🇸


# ❤ **How does it work?**

Every player starts with **10 permanent hearts**.

Whenever a player dies, regardless of the cause:

> 💀 They lose **1 permanent heart**.

Their maximum health is automatically reduced to match the number of hearts they have left.

If the player was killed by another player:

> ❤ The killer steals **1 permanent heart** from the victim.

This increases the killer's maximum health while permanently reducing the victim's.

---

# ❤ **Heart Limits**

* **Minimum:** 1 heart.
* **Starting:** 10 hearts.
* **Maximum:** **20 hearts**.

No player can exceed **20 permanent hearts**, no matter how many players they eliminate.

![DIED MESSAGE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/76e56f9215a43216bd7b1f071313c0fbcd223c1a.png)

---

# ☠ **Elimination**

When a player loses all of their hearts and dies again:

> ☠ They are automatically eliminated.

Once eliminated:

* They are switched to **Spectator Mode**.
* They are moved to the **SPECS** team.
* A global message announces their elimination.
* The **Pigstep** music disc is played for every player on the server.
* A small grave with particles appears at the place where they died.

![ELIMINATED MESSAGE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fdcdbe9c81c9cf2ff2f4a9eadfe05eea233fd762.png)

---

# 🚫 **No Heart Recovery**

Unlike many other Lifesteal-inspired datapacks, **LIFELESS** **does not include any alternative way to recover hearts**.

This means:

* ❌ No items exist to transfer hearts between players.
* ❌ Hearts cannot be crafted using custom recipes.
* ❌ Hearts cannot be gifted or traded.
* ❌ There are no mechanics that allow players to recover hearts artificially.

> ❤ The **only** way to gain a heart is by **eliminating another player**.

This design creates a much more challenging and balanced experience where every fight has meaningful and permanent consequences.

This behavior is inspired by the original **LifeSteal SMP** series, where players also had no way to craft, transfer, or give away hearts outside of the core kill mechanic.

---

# 📊 **HUD**

While playing, you'll always have an **Action Bar** displaying real-time information.

It shows:

* 👤 Your username.
* ❤ Remaining hearts.
* ⚔ Kills.
* ☠ Deaths.

![HUB](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9a0f321cd600c0381ce84f5107117764c893068.png)

---

# 💬 **Custom Messages**

LIFELESS includes several custom messages and visual effects to improve the gameplay experience.

When a player dies:

> ☠ A title is displayed on their screen.

> 🔊 A custom sound is played.

> 💬 A global chat message announces who died and how many hearts they have remaining.

When a player eliminates another player:

> ❤ The killer receives a message informing them that they gained a heart, along with their new total.

![CUSTOM MESSAGES](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2a4d6f08d9a00d1ea7bee3eed536046d615013e.png)

---

# 🛠 **Useful Commands**

## Reset the entire game

```mcfunction
/function lifeless:reset
```

> Completely resets the datapack.

This includes:

* ❤ Every player is restored to 10 hearts.
* ⚔ Kills and deaths are reset.
* 👥 Every player is moved back to the **ALIVE** team.
* 🎮 Everyone is returned to Survival Mode.

---

## Reset a single player

```mcfunction
/function lifeless:player_reset
```

> Resets only the player executing the command.

Perfect for administrators who want to bring an eliminated player back into the game.

---

## Reload the datapack

```mcfunction
/reload
```

> Reloads all datapack functions without restarting the world.

---

# ⭐ **Recommended For**

* SMP servers.
* PvP events.
* Survival challenges with friends.
* Multiplayer survival worlds.
* Lifesteal-inspired servers.

**Will you survive... or lose all of your hearts?**
